## What's new in 1.21.3

- Fixed: the spaces and budget categories created with your account now switch to the new language right away when you change it, without reopening Aqueli.

## Install

Download `Aqueli_1.21.3_x64-setup.exe` below and run it. It installs Aqueli for your Windows user account, without administrator rights, and keeps your data from the previous version.

The installer is not code-signed yet: if Windows SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC", choose More info, then Run anyway.
